title: The Storm is back — come build your next home
message:
Welcome to a new chapter of The Storm! Whether you played years ago or are finding us for the first time, there is room to help shape what comes next.

[B]Build a town. Trade with your neighbors. Brave The Storm.[/B]

Explore survival with towns and land claims, quests around Spawn Town, a crystal economy, and Storm Shards that improve equipment. When you want a change of pace, try cooperative arenas or Search and Destroy.

[B]Join from Java or Bedrock[/B]
Java: [B]ts-mc.net[/B] (26.2).
Bedrock: address [B]mc.ts-mc.net[/B], port [B]30004[/B]. Check the homepage for supported Bedrock versions and current status. No forum account is required to play.

[B]Your first session[/B]
You arrive at the windmill with tools, food, a welcome book, and 500 crystals. Read [B]/guide[/B] and [B]/rules[/B], meet Anna for a daily reward, then use [B]/rtp[/B] to find land. Found a town with [B]/town create <name>[/B], protect your chunk with [B]/claim[/B], and save your spot with [B]/sethome[/B].

Spawn is PvP-free; outside it, PvP is enabled by default. Use [B]/pvp off[/B] to opt out; you can change it once a week. No griefing. Unlocked containers are fair game where access permits, so keep your supplies locked.

[URL=https://docs.ts-mc.net/join/]How to join[/URL] · [URL=https://docs.ts-mc.net/getting-started/]Your first session[/URL] · [URL=https://docs.ts-mc.net/discord/]Discord[/URL]

The restored discussions below are part of our history and are staying here. This revival is just getting started: introduce yourself, share what you are building, and help make the next chapter worth remembering.
